All 9 tests now pass (`node --test`). I changed only the source, one line in each file.

**Bugs**
1. **`src/bill.js`, `splitBill`:** there was an off-by-one in the leftover-cent check. `i <= leftover` handed an extra cent to `leftover + 1` people, so the shares added up to more than the total. For example, 900 split three ways gave `[301, 300, 300]`. It is now `i < leftover`.
2. **`src/duration.js`, `parseDuration`:** the input was never checked as a whole. The code only threw when nothing matched, so `"10m and change"` parsed as 10 minutes and `"3d"` was accepted too. It now throws a `SyntaxError` unless the entire string is made of `<digits><h|m|s>` pairs (`/^(\d+[hms])+$/`).

I made both fixes myself rather than delegating, since each was a one-line change.
